area: Online, with same-day delivery across Dubai
name: Rawsome Patisserie
questions: Which 'ancient grains' do you use? Do any products contain quinoa or oats?
Can you give ingredient lists for the bases?
quinoa_oat_flags: The company blog mentions 'ancient grains' in its GF cakes, which could mean quinoa or oats. Check each product's ingredients. Raw cheesecake and pie bases are often oat-based.

safe_dishes.note: The site says all desserts are made without gluten and refined sugar

summary: A delivery-only patisserie whose whole range is made without gluten. Check every product for oats or quinoa because of the 'ancient grains' wording.
